title: Fantastic support
content: I have had a very positive experience with your Social Subscriber. She signposted me to other forms of help. Really listened to what I had to say and most importantly she treated me like a human being. She helped me to set small goals and followed up with me a few weeks later to see how I was doing. Thank you very much. I would highly recommend this service.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
